Theory will not get you through. Expect:
Production walkthrough show us a live or previously deployed agent. Walk us through the architecture, what failed, and how you resolved it
Cost breakdown explain the token/compute cost of a system you built and how you optimized it

Agents running in production, not in slides

Portfolio of tutorials and Jupyter notebooks with no deployment history

Academic research or model training

Building without a business case
Remote working

Are you passionate about solving complex problems Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment Then there s a good chance you will love being a part of our Software Engineering Development team at Kyndryl, where you will be able to see the immediate value of your work.

As a Software Engineering - Developer at Kyndryl, you will be at the forefront of designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge software solutions. Your work will play a critical role in our business offering, your code will deliver value to our customers faster than ever before, and your attention to detail and commitment to quality will be critical in ensuring the success of our products.

Using design documentation and functional programming specifications, you will be responsible for implementing identified components. You will ensure that implemented components are appropriately documented, unit-tested, and ready for integration into the final product. You will have the opportunity to architect the solution, test the code, and deploy and build a CI/CD pipeline for it.

As a valued member of our team, you will provide work estimates for assigned development work, and guide features, functional objectives, or technologies being built for interested parties. Your contributions will have a significant impact on our products success, and you will be part of a team that is passionate about innovation, creativity, and excellence. Above all else, you will have the freedom to drive innovation and take ownership of your work while honing your problem-solving, collaboration, and automation skills. Together, we can make a difference in the world of cloud-based managed services.

Who You Are

You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you're open and borderless naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Experience
1-3 years of experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects
Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills
Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark.
Agentic AI Systems is a plus: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Knowledge Systems is a plus: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions.
Cloud Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures.
Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, Rest based web services
Deep understanding of OOP and Design patterns
Preferred Technical and Professional Experience
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl
Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices

Job Overview:

We are seeking a GenAI Developer to design, develop, and integrate AI-powered modules into mobile and web applications. The role focuses on leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, integrating APIs, and optimizing AI models for production. The ideal candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement robust, scalable, and high-performance GenAI solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and integrate LLM-based and RAG-powered modules into applications
Work with AI APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex
Fine-tune, test, and optimize AI models for production environments
Collaborate with backend, data, and frontend teams to integrate GenAI solutions
Implement best practices for model deployment, performance optimization, and reliability
Maintain documentation for AI pipelines, API integrations, and model configurations.

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related fields.

Preferred: Specialization in Machine Learning, AI, or Cloud Computing.

Professional Experience:

3-4 years of experience in AI/ML development or software engineering with GenAI focus
Proven experience integrating APIs and AI frameworks into applications
Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, and vector databases.

Technical Skills:

Proficiency in Python and AI/ML libraries (e
g
, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face)
Experience with API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc
) and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex
Understanding of vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate)
Knowledge of prompt engineering and end-to-end GenAI pipelines
Familiarity with model fine-tuning, testing, and deployment in production environments
Certifications (Optional):AI/ML certifications or cloud-based AI certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure) are a plus

Other Requirements:

Strong collaboration skills to work with AI, backend, and product teams
Problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and high coding standards
Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills

Location - Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Mumbai, Gurugram, Chennai, Noida
